基础输入与操作

自动补全 AsamAutocomplete

保留文本输入，并以静态选项或建议函数提供候选。

使用场景 ​

用于地址、名称等允许自由输入的补全。ASAM options 模式按 label 过滤并忽略禁用选项，选中时返回原 option 对象。模型保存显示文本；需要固定选项值模型时使用 Select。

ASAM 静态选项 ​

maxSuggestions 默认 100，必须是正整数；仅限制 ASAM options/数据桥接建议。匹配选择的 select 返回原选项，包含业务 value、label、raw 及扩展字段，保持对象 identity。建议数组、默认插槽与 handleSelect 仍只接受完整候选。

ASAM 静态选项

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '城市补全' }"
			:options="options"
			:max-suggestions="3"
			clearable
			@select="(item) => (selected = JSON.stringify(item))"
		/>
		<output>文本：{{ value }}；选项：{{ selected }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteOptionsExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref('');
const selected = ref('尚未选择');
const options: AsamOption<string>[] = [
	{ value: 'shanghai', label: '上海', raw: { code: 'SH' } },
	{ value: 'beijing', label: '北京', raw: { code: 'BJ' } },
	{ value: 'closed', label: '停用城市', disabled: true, raw: { code: 'OFF' } }
];
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.field {
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 360px;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>

函数建议与多文件数据 ​

fetchSuggestions 优先于 options，支持数组、callback 或返回数组的 Promise。valueKey 指定建议的显示字段；原函数建议不会被 maxSuggestions 截断。

装饰与建议实例 ​

公开状态包含 activated、loading、suggestions、highlightedIndex；getData、handleSelect、handleKeyEnter 是异步实例方法。

实例按钮会先建立输入焦点并等待建议渲染；高亮首项获取“上”的建议后高亮上海，按 Enter 可选中。关闭建议保留已输入的值。示例同时组合 prefix、suffix、prepend、append，并使用 Close 图标提供可操作的清空入口；清空后模型同步为空，可再次获取和选择建议。

装饰与建议实例

展开源码
vue
<!-- 此演示还使用 @asam-ui/icons-vue，请按官网对应指南配置这些公开依赖。 -->
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<div class="row">
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="focusInput"> 聚焦补全 </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="getCitySuggestions"> 获取建议 </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="highlightFirst"> 高亮首项 </AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" @click="input?.close()"> 关闭建议 </AsamButton>
		</div>
		<AsamAutocomplete
			ref="input"
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '实例补全' }"
			:options="options"
			:debounce="0"
			clearable
			:clear-icon="Close"
		>
			<template #prefix>
				<Search style="width: 16px" />
			</template>
			<template #suffix> 补全 </template>
			<template #prepend> 城市搜索 </template>
			<template #append> 城市 </template>
		</AsamAutocomplete>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteInstanceExample' });
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteExpose, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { Search, Close } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const input = ref<AsamAutocompleteExpose>();
const value = ref('');
const options: AsamOption<string>[] = [
	{ value: 'shanghai', label: '上海', raw: { code: 'SH' } },
	{ value: 'beijing', label: '北京', raw: { code: 'BJ' } }
];
async function prepareSuggestions(query: string) {
	// The button takes focus first. Let the previous native blur close finish
	// before establishing a new focused, rendered suggestions panel.
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
	const control = input.value;
	if (!control) return;
	control.focus();
	await nextTick();
	await control.getData(query);
	await nextTick();
}
async function focusInput() {
	await prepareSuggestions(value.value);
}
async function getCitySuggestions() {
	await prepareSuggestions('上');
}
async function highlightFirst() {
	await prepareSuggestions('上');
	input.value?.highlight(0);
}
</script>

四档密度与继承 ​

large / big / default / small 分别为四档密度。显式 size 覆盖继承；省略 size 时按组件、组、表单、ConfigProvider 到 default 解析。通过切换 provider 验证继承响应。

				:fetch-suggestions="[]"

			<AsamAutocomplete

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展是 options、maxSuggestions 与原对象回传。 完整说明。

浮层配置 ​

showArrow 与 popperOptions 作用于实际建议浮层；teleported 控制是否传送，appendTo 可指定容器，fitInputWidth 匹配输入宽度。popperClass/popperStyle 配置浮层样式；传送到 body 的浮层不会自动继承局部主题变量。

异步建议与键盘提交 ​

fetchSuggestions 支持数组、回调、同步数组或 Promise；设置它时优先于 ASAM options/remoteSuggestions，原生建议不会被 maxSuggestions 截断。 完整说明。

debounce 控制查询防抖，triggerOnFocus 控制聚焦查询，highlightFirstItem 高亮首项，loopNavigation 决定方向键是否环绕。 完整说明。

select 的类型为 T | AsamOption<V, I> | { value: string | number }。 完整说明。

异步建议、加载与未匹配提交

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="query"
			:fetch-suggestions="fetchSuggestions"
			:debounce="100"
			:trigger-on-focus="false"
			select-when-unmatched
			highlight-first-item
			:loop-navigation="false"
			aria-label="异步建议"
			@select="handleSelect"
		>
			<template #default="{ item }">
				{{ item.value }} · {{ 'id' in item ? item.id : '' }}
			</template>
			<template #loading>查询中，请稍候</template>
		</AsamAutocomplete>
		<output>选择：{{ selected }}</output>
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			输入后等待本地异步建议，选择建议查看完整对象。输入“自由输入”后等待空建议再按
			Enter，查看只有 value 的载荷；消费方先收窄再读取完整候选字段。
		</p>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteAsyncExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits, AsamValue, AsamRecord } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Suggestion {
	value: string;
	id: number;
}
const query = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
async function fetchSuggestions(query: string): Promise<Suggestion[]> {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400));
	return query === '自由输入' ? [] : [{ value: query + ' suggestion', id: 42 }];
}
function handleSelect(item: AsamAutocompleteEmits<AsamValue, AsamRecord, Suggestion>['select'][0]) {
	if ('id' in item) selected.value = `匹配建议 #${item.id}：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
	else if ('label' in item) selected.value = `匹配选项 ${item.label}：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
	else selected.value = `未匹配：${JSON.stringify(item)}`;
}
</script>

数组、回调和 Promise 协议

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="arrayValue"
			:fetch-suggestions="items"
			aria-label="数组建议"
		/><AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="callbackValue"
			:fetch-suggestions="callback"
			select-when-unmatched
			aria-label="回调建议"
			@select="selected = JSON.stringify($event)"
		/><AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="promiseValue"
			:fetch-suggestions="promise"
			aria-label="Promise建议"
		/><output>{{ selected }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeProtocolsExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const arrayValue = ref('');
const callbackValue = ref('');
const promiseValue = ref('');
const selected = ref('');
const items = [
	{ value: 'Alpha', code: 'a' },
	{ value: 'Beta', code: 'b' }
];
const filter = (query: string) =>
	items.filter((item) => item.value.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));
function callback(query: string, done: (items: { value: string; code: string }[]) => void) {
	done(filter(query));
}
async function promise(query: string) {
	return filter(query);
}
</script>

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}

output {
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 API 来自当前公开类型与运行默认值。默认值标为“未知 / 未声明”时，不代表 false、空值或未支持。省略 size 保留祖先上下文继承。省略 disabled 保留表单禁用继承；validateEvent 控制校验事件，不用 disabled 代替。

省略 showArrow 时沿用原生 true 默认；显式 false 隐藏建议浮层箭头。

完整继承输入组合 ​

min/max/step、formatter/parser、modelModifiers 与 textarea 参数原样交给 底层输入。 完整说明。

ASAM options/remoteSuggestions 分支继续按 label 过滤、忽略 disabled 项并保留原选项对象与 maxSuggestions 上限。 完整说明。

完整继承输入组合

展开源码

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="numeric"
			:fetch-suggestions="options"

			:step="0.5"
			aria-label="原生约束"

		<AsamAutocomplete

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeInputExample' });

const amount = ref<string | number>('1234');

五入口表单继承与校验 ​

本完整 TS/JS 组合实际实例化单行、密码、多行、建议和标签五个入口。省略各入口 disabled 以继承表单状态；validateEvent 控制各自 change/blur 自动校验。切换禁用不会清空模型，关闭自动校验不影响编辑。五页注册同一组合源码的自包含副本，复制当前示例即可运行，无需从其他组件页补齐文件。

五入口表单继承与校验

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCheckboxItem
			v-model="disabled"
			aria-label="禁用五入口表单">禁用整个表单</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="validateEvent" aria-label="五入口自动校验">自动
			change/blur 校验</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamBaseForm
			ref="form"
			:model="model"
			:rules="rules"
			:disabled="disabled"
			@validate="record"
		>
			<AsamFormItem
				label="单行"
				prop="input"
			>
				<AsamInput
					v-model="model.input"
					:validate-event="validateEvent"
					aria-label="表单单行"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
			<AsamFormItem
				label="密码"
				prop="password"
			>
				<AsamPassword
					v-model="model.password"
					:validate-event="validateEvent"
					aria-label="表单密码"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
			<AsamFormItem
				label="多行"
				prop="textarea"
			>
				<AsamTextarea
					v-model="model.textarea"
					:validate-event="validateEvent"
					aria-label="表单多行"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
			<AsamFormItem
				label="建议"
				prop="autocomplete"
			>
				<AsamAutocomplete
					v-model="model.autocomplete"
					:fetch-suggestions="suggestions"
					:validate-event="validateEvent"
					aria-label="表单建议"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
			<AsamFormItem
				label="标签"
				prop="tags"
			>
				<AsamInputTag
					v-model="model.tags"
					:validate-event="validateEvent"
					aria-label="表单标签"
				/>
			</AsamFormItem>
		</AsamBaseForm>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reset">重置模型和校验记录</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">提交编辑</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ model, disabled, validateEvent, validations }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamBaseForm,
	AsamFormItem,
	AsamInput,
	AsamPassword,
	AsamTextarea,
	AsamAutocomplete,
	AsamInputTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamBaseFormExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamFiveInputsFormExample' });
const model = ref({
	input: '',
	password: '',
	textarea: '',
	autocomplete: '',
	tags: [] as string[]
});
const disabled = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const form = ref<AsamBaseFormExpose>();
const rules = Object.fromEntries(
	['input', 'password', 'textarea', 'autocomplete', 'tags'].map((key) => [
		key,
		[{ required: true, message: '请完善此项', trigger: ['change', 'blur'] }]
	])
);
const suggestions = [{ value: 'Alpha' }];
const validations = ref<{ prop: string; valid: boolean }[]>([]);
function record(prop: string | string[], valid: boolean) {
	validations.value.push({ prop: String(prop), valid });
}
function reset() {
	model.value = { input: '', password: '', textarea: '', autocomplete: '', tags: [] };
	validations.value = [];
	form.value?.clearValidate();
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

异步建议与动态只读禁用 ​

readonly、disabled 和继承表单状态原样委托原生。它们控制原生 UI 的可编辑性；公开 handleSelect、键盘选择及异步建议期间的具体行为以 底层输入 2.14.7 为准，ASAM 不额外过滤原生发出的模型和 select 事件。父级仍可更新模型。

异步建议与动态只读禁用

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<!-- prettier-ignore -->
	<div class="example">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用表单</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamBaseForm
			:model="{ value }"
			:disabled="disabled"
		>
			<AsamAutocomplete
				v-model="value"
				:readonly="readonly"
				:fetch-suggestions="suggestions"
				highlight-first-item
				aria-label="动态异步建议"
				@update:model-value="events.push('update')"
				@select="events.push('select')"
			/>
		</AsamBaseForm>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, readonly, disabled, events }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamBaseForm, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteStateExample' });
const value = ref('');
const readonly = ref(true);
const disabled = ref(false);
const events = ref<string[]>([]);
async function suggestions() {
	await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
	return [{ value: 'Alpha' }];
}
</script>

	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}

继承输入事件 ​

compositionstart、compositionupdate、compositionend 的参数均为 CompositionEvent，携带输入合成数据。 完整说明。

继承输入事件与候选键盘操作

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			:debounce="0"
			clearable
			aria-label="补全继承输入事件"
			@keydown="keyed"
			@mouseenter="entered"
			@mouseleave="left"
			@compositionstart="started"
			@compositionupdate="updated"
			@compositionend="ended"
			@select="record('select', $event)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">移出输入焦点</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ JSON.stringify({ value, events }) }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAutocompleteEmits } from '@asam-ui/ui';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteEventsDemo' });
const value = ref('');
const options = [{ value: 'alpha', label: 'Alpha', raw: { id: 'alpha' } }];
const events = ref<{ name: string; value: unknown }[]>([]);
function record(name: string, value: unknown) {
	events.value.push({ name, value });
}
function keyed(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['keydown']) {
	record('keydown', event instanceof KeyboardEvent ? event.key : event.type);
}
function entered(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['mouseenter']) {
	record('mouseenter', event.type);
}
function left(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['mouseleave']) {
	record('mouseleave', event.type);
}
function started(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionstart']) {
	record('compositionstart', event.data);
}
function updated(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionupdate']) {
	record('compositionupdate', event.data);
}
function ended(...[event]: AsamAutocompleteEmits['compositionend']) {
	record('compositionend', event.data);
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

动态原生类型与状态保留 ​

原生委托与事件记录 ​

下方完整 TS/JS 示例记录模型及事件顺序，并可切换禁用、只读和自动校验状态。 完整说明。

原生委托与事件记录

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="native-comparison">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="readonly">只读</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="validateEvent">自动校验</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<p class="example-paragraph">ASAM</p>
		<AsamAutocomplete
			v-model="asam"
			:disabled="disabled"
			:readonly="readonly"
			:validate-event="validateEvent"
			:fetch-suggestions="suggestions"
			:debounce="0"
			aria-label="ASAM 原生委托"
			@update:model-value="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'update:modelValue', ...args)"
			@input="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'input', ...args)"
			@change="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'change', ...args)"
			@blur="(...args) => record('ASAM', 'blur', ...args)"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="events = []"
			>清空事件记录</AsamButton
		>
		<pre>{{ JSON.stringify({ asam, events }, null, 2) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteNativeDelegationExample' });
const asam = ref<string | number>('');
const disabled = ref(false);
const readonly = ref(false);
const validateEvent = ref(true);
const suggestions = [{ value: 'Alpha', label: 'Alpha' }];
const events = ref<{ source: string; event: string; values: unknown[] }[]>([]);
function record(source: string, event: string, ...values: unknown[]) {
	events.value.push({
		source,
		event,
		values: values.map((value) => (value instanceof Event ? value.type : value))
	});
}
</script>
<style scoped>
.native-comparison {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

局部与全局挂载 ​

切换公开挂载参数后，再打开浮层观察内容位于当前组件附近或挂载到 body。 开关显示当前模式，两个模式均可操作；关闭后可以再次切换。

局部与全局挂载

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div ref="mountTarget" class="popup-stage" :class="{ local: !globalPopup }">
		<div class="popup-mode">
			<ContainerSwitch
				v-model="globalPopup"
				active-text="全局挂载到 body"
				inactive-text="局部挂载到当前区域"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="example">
			<AsamAutocomplete
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="{ class: 'field', 'aria-label': '城市补全' }"
				:options="options"
				:max-suggestions="3"
				clearable
				@select="(item) => (selected = JSON.stringify(item))"
				:teleported="globalPopup"
			/>
			<output>文本：{{ value }}；选项：{{ selected }}</output>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamAutocompleteOptionsExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamAutocomplete } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref('');
const selected = ref('尚未选择');
const options: AsamOption<string>[] = [
	{ value: 'shanghai', label: '上海', raw: { code: 'SH' } },
	{ value: 'beijing', label: '北京', raw: { code: 'BJ' } },
	{ value: 'closed', label: '停用城市', disabled: true, raw: { code: 'OFF' } }
];

import { ref as containerRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSwitch as ContainerSwitch } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const globalPopup = containerRef(true);
const mountTarget = containerRef<HTMLElement>();
</script>

<style scoped>
.example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);
	min-width: 0;
}

.row {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: var(--asam-space-sm, 8px);
}

.field {
	width: 100%;
	max-width: 360px;
}

output {
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
	color: var(--asam-color-text-secondary);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
.popup-stage {
	position: relative;
	isolation: isolate;
	min-height: 140px;
	padding: var(--asam-space-md);
	border: 1px dashed var(--asam-color-border);
}

.popup-mode {
	margin-bottom: var(--asam-space-lg);
}
</style>

API

属性 AsamAutocompleteProps

属性名说明类型默认值
modelValue字符串或数字输入值。string | number | undefined—
min原生输入的上下界和步长，补充 InputProps 未声明的属性。(string | number) | undefined—
max—(string | number) | undefined—
step—(string | number) | undefined—
optionsASAM 静态选项，按标签筛选并尊重禁用状态。readonly AsamOption<V, I>[] | undefined—
fetchSuggestions原生建议项优先于静态选项。AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions<T> | undefined—
maxSuggestionsASAM 静态或远程选项的最大建议数；不截断原生建议项。number | undefined—
remoteSuggestions保留 ASAM 选项对象的数据层连接。((query: string) => Promise<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>) | undefined—
id原生 id 能力。string | undefined—
size显式控件密度；省略时保留继承。enum"large" | "big" | "default" | "small"完整类型：AsamControlSize | undefined—
disabled原生 disabled 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
modelModifiers原生 modelModifiers 能力。(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["modelModifiers"]—
maxlength原生 maxlength 能力。string | number | undefined—
minlength原生 minlength 能力。string | number | undefined—
type原生 type 能力。enum"number" | "text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "textarea" | "password"完整类型：(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["type"]—
resize原生 resize 能力。enum"horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | "both"完整类型："horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | "both" | undefined—
autosize原生 autosize 能力。(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["autosize"]false
autocomplete原生 autocomplete 能力。string | undefined—
formatter原生 formatter 能力。((value: string) => string) | undefined—
parser原生 parser 能力。((value: string) => string) | undefined—
placeholder原生 placeholder 能力。string | undefined—
form原生 form 能力。string | undefined—
readonly原生 readonly 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
clearable原生 clearable 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
clearIcon原生 clearIcon 能力。(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["clearIcon"]—
showPassword原生 showPassword 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
showWordLimit原生 showWordLimit 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
wordLimitPosition原生 wordLimitPosition 能力。enum"outside" | "inside"完整类型："outside" | "inside" | undefined—
suffixIcon原生 suffixIcon 能力。(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["suffixIcon"]—
prefixIcon原生 prefixIcon 能力。(AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["prefixIcon"]—
containerRole原生 containerRole 能力。string | undefined—
tabindex原生 tabindex 能力。string | number | undefined—
validateEvent原生 validateEvent 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
inputStyle原生 inputStyle 能力。import("vue").StyleValuefalse
autofocus原生 autofocus 能力。boolean | undefinedfalse
rows原生 rows 能力。number | undefined—
ariaLabel原生 ariaLabel 能力。string | undefined—
inputmode原生 inputmode 能力。enum"text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal"完整类型："text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal" | undefined—
name原生 name 能力。string | undefined—

用法与契约补充说明 ​

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 扩展是 options、maxSuggestions 与原对象回传。remoteSuggestions 是数据层桥接，应用远程/provider 能力使用本站 RemoteAutocomplete。密码和普通多行文本分别使用 Password、Textarea。省略 size 保留四档继承，建议面板参数按本页完整 API 配置。

异步建议与键盘提交 ​

fetchSuggestions 支持数组、回调、同步数组或 Promise；设置它时优先于 ASAM options/remoteSuggestions，原生建议不会被 maxSuggestions 截断。ASAM 静态 options 过滤 label/disabled，选中后的字符串模型是 label，select 保留原选项及扩展字段。远程数据包装见 AsamRemoteAutocomplete。

异步建议与键盘提交 ​

debounce 控制查询防抖，triggerOnFocus 控制聚焦查询，highlightFirstItem 高亮首项，loopNavigation 决定方向键是否环绕。selectWhenUnmatched 为 true 时，没有高亮匹配候选的 Enter 会发出 { value: modelValue }；value 保留 string 或 number，即使自定义 valueKey 也仍使用 value 字段，不补造 label、raw 或业务字段。false 或省略时不发出这种 select。真实 Enter 和实例 handleKeyEnter 遵循同一协议；loading 插槽可替换加载标记。header/footer/default 展示列表附加内容和完整候选。

异步建议与键盘提交 ​

select 的类型为 T | AsamOption<V, I> | { value: string | number }。消费方访问 label/raw 或自定义字段前，先按字段存在性收窄：'label' in item 承接完整 ASAM 选项，'id' in item 承接示例的完整原生建议，其余分支只读取 value。下方完整 TS/JS 示例同时展示匹配原对象与未匹配最小载荷，输入“自由输入”后等待空建议再按 Enter。

完整继承输入组合 ​

min/max/step、formatter/parser、modelModifiers 与 textarea 参数原样交给 底层输入。原生分支只在未配置 options/remoteSuggestions，或已提供 fetchSuggestions 时使用；该分支不增加 placeholder、debounce 或 valueKey 默认值。省略 fetchSuggestions 后要获取建议，须先提供原生数组或函数；原生缺少建议源时的查询限制保持。

完整继承输入组合 ​

ASAM options/remoteSuggestions 分支继续按 label 过滤、忽略 disabled 项并保留原选项对象与 maxSuggestions 上限。两分支的输入、lazy、密码显隐、表单 change/blur 校验都由原生输入处理；ASAM 不保存独立草稿、不自动补交、不去重或强制恢复父级模型。

继承输入事件 ​

compositionstart、compositionupdate、compositionend 的参数均为 CompositionEvent，携带输入合成数据。mouseenter、mouseleave 的参数为 MouseEvent；keydown 接受 KeyboardEvent | Event，保留原生输入分支的 Event 边界。这六类事件从实际输入转发，每个实际事件通知一次；键盘监听保留内部方向键高亮和 Enter 选择逻辑。focus、blur 继续携带 FocusEvent；input/change 携带模型值，select 携带完整匹配候选或上述未匹配 value-only 载荷。

原生委托与事件记录 ​

下方完整 TS/JS 示例记录模型及事件顺序，并可切换禁用、只读和自动校验状态。省略的基础参数使用原生 defaults；显式 undefined/null/false 原样传入，合法值范围见 API。四档 size 是 ASAM 的视觉桥接；Password 额外固定 type=password，并在省略 showPassword 时启用显隐入口。

关联组件

单行输入 AsamInput选择器 AsamSelect远端自动补全 AsamRemoteAutocomplete密码输入 AsamPassword多行文本 AsamTextarea全局配置 AsamConfigProvider

ts
import type { Attrs } from 'vue';
import type { AsamAutocompleteProps, AsamValue, AsamRecord, AsamOption, AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions, AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamAutocompleteProps
type PublicContract<V extends AsamValue = AsamValue, I extends object = AsamRecord, T extends object = AsamOption<V, I>> = {
	readonly "modelValue"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "min"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "max"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "step"?: (string | number) | undefined;
	readonly "options"?: readonly AsamOption<V, I>[] | undefined;
	readonly "fetchSuggestions"?: AsamAutocompleteFetchSuggestions<T> | undefined;
	readonly "maxSuggestions"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "remoteSuggestions"?: ((query: string) => Promise<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]>) | undefined;
	readonly "id"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "size"?: AsamControlSize | undefined;
	readonly "disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "modelModifiers"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["modelModifiers"];
	readonly "maxlength"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "minlength"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "type"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["type"];
	readonly "resize"?: "horizontal" | "vertical" | "none" | "both" | undefined;
	readonly "autosize"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["autosize"];
	readonly "autocomplete"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "formatter"?: ((value: string) => string) | undefined;
	readonly "parser"?: ((value: string) => string) | undefined;
	readonly "placeholder"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "form"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "readonly"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "clearable"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "clearIcon"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["clearIcon"];
	readonly "showPassword"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "showWordLimit"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "wordLimitPosition"?: "outside" | "inside" | undefined;
	readonly "suffixIcon"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["suffixIcon"];
	readonly "prefixIcon"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["prefixIcon"];
	readonly "containerRole"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "tabindex"?: string | number | undefined;
	readonly "validateEvent"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "inputStyle"?: import("vue").StyleValue;
	readonly "autofocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "rows"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "ariaLabel"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "inputmode"?: "text" | "email" | "search" | "tel" | "url" | "none" | "numeric" | "decimal" | undefined;
	readonly "name"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "countGraphemes"?: ((value: string) => number) | undefined;
	readonly "valueKey"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "debounce"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "placement"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["placement"];
	readonly "popperClass"?: AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>["popperClass"];
	readonly "popperStyle"?: import("vue").StyleValue;
	readonly "popperOptions"?: (AsamAutocompleteProps<V, I, T>)["popperOptions"];
	readonly "showArrow"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "triggerOnFocus"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "selectWhenUnmatched"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "hideLoading"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "teleported"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "appendTo"?: string | HTMLElement | undefined;
	readonly "highlightFirstItem"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "fitInputWidth"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "loopNavigation"?: boolean | undefined;
};

type PublicContract<T extends object = AsamRecord> = {
	readonly "highlightedIndex": number;
	readonly "activated": boolean;
	readonly "loading": boolean;
	readonly "inputRef": (AsamAutocompleteExpose<T>)["inputRef"];
	readonly "popperRef": (AsamAutocompleteExpose<T>)["popperRef"];
	readonly "suggestions": T[];
	"focus": () => void;
	"blur": () => void;
	"close": () => void;
	"highlight": (index: number) => void;
	"getData": (query: string) => Promise<void>;
	"handleSelect": (item: T) => Promise<void>;
	"handleKeyEnter": () => Promise<void>;
};
